profile.name: 通用TCP探测器/数据采集设备
profile.name_en: Generic TCP Detector / Data Acquisition Instrument
profile.description: 这是一类通过 TCP/IP 与上位机通信的通用实验探测器或数据采集设备，可输出标量、一维曲线或二维图像数据。它适合把远程传感器、线阵/面阵探测器、相机或其他测量前端接入实验自动化系统，用于实时采集、传输和显示测量结果。
profile.description_en: This is a generic laboratory detector or data acquisition instrument that communicates with a host computer over TCP/IP and can provide scalar, 1D trace, or 2D image data. It is suitable for integrating remote sensors, line or area detectors, cameras, or other measurement front ends into an automated lab system for real-time acquisition, transfer, and display of measurement data.

registry.name: National Instruments DAQ Viewer Tcp
registry.description: DAQ Viewer TCP Server是由National Instruments生产的表征设备，主要功能包括停止、关闭、初始化、扫描、状态查询、读取数据。
